about.title: Gutumiza grocery hifashishijwe stock y'ishami ku baguzi bo muri Kigali.
about.subtitle: Tumiza agaseke kawe kuri internet kandi ukakirize cyangwa ukakagemurirwa uhereye ku ishami wahisemo.
about.body: Simba ihuza abakiliya na stock nyayo y'ishami mbere ya checkout. Abakiliya bahitamo ishami, bakabika ibicuruzwa bihari, kandi bagakurikirana itumiza mu buryo bugaragara ku bakozi.
about.card.clientBody: Abakiliya bareba ibicuruzwa bigurishwa, bashakisha muri katalogi yose, kandi bakabona ibidahari byanditse neza.
about.card.adminBody: Abayobozi b'ishami bagenzura stock yabo, ibigaragara mu iduka, itumiza, n'ibitekerezo by'abakiliya.
about.card.flowBody: App itandukanya stock n'ibigaragara mu iduka kugira ngo igicuruzwa kidashyirwa hanze kidafite stock.
